name: alert-dialog-06
title: Unsaved Changes Alert Dialog
description: A confirmation for leaving with unsaved changes

files.content:
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/registry/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/registry/ui/button";

export default function AlertDialogUnsavedChangesDemo() {
  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>
        Close Editor
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Save changes before closing?</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            Your edits to Quarterly report haven't been saved. If you leave
            now, they will be lost.
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel className="sm:mr-auto" variant="destructive">
            Discard
          </AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction>Save changes</AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
